summary: Builders FirstSource filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 results (net sales $3.3B, down 10.1%; net loss $47.4M) and announced a $500M share repurchase authorization. The buyback is a capital-return event, not a formal tender offer; the board authorized it without stated expiration. No price per share, premium, or advisor was specified. The program will be funded from operations, allowing open-market purchases at management's discretion. Watch for actual repurchase cadence and potential EPS accretion; the risk-arb angle is limited as this is an open-market program, not a tender.
